When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
library(readr)
library(pROC)
library(tidyverse)
library(geepack)   # for GEE
library(lme4)      # for GLMM (lmer, glmer)
library(broom)     # for tidy() tables


########################################
## 1. Read & Clean Data
########################################

# Replace with your actual file name / path
oasis_raw <- read.csv("C:\\Users\\19193\\Downloads\\oasis_longitudinal.csv") 
oasis <- oasis_raw %>%
  rename(
    subject_id   = Subject.ID,   # already cleaned
    mri_id       = MRI.ID,
    group        = Group,
    visit        = Visit,
    mr_delay     = MR.Delay,
    sex          = M.F,          # rename M.F → sex
    hand         = Hand,
    age          = Age,
    educ         = EDUC,
    ses          = SES,
    mmse         = MMSE,
    cdr          = CDR,
    etiv         = eTIV,
    nwbv         = nWBV,
    asf          = ASF
  )

# Assume we now have:
# subject_id, visit, mr_delay, age, m_f, educ, ses, mmse, cdr, group
# If names differ, change them in the code below.

########################################
## 2. Create Time & Derived Variables
########################################

oasis <- oasis%>%
  mutate(
    # Time in years since baseline MRI
    time_years = mr_delay / 365,
    # Centered time
    time_c = time_years - mean(time_years, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Binary poor cognition indicator (MMSE < 24 is common cutoff)
    poor_cognition = if_else(mmse < 24, 1L, 0L),
    
    # Make factors nicely labeled
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("F", "M")),
    group = factor(group),         # e.g., "Nondemented", "Demented"
    subject_id = factor(subject_id)
  )

########################################
## 3. Build Dataset for GLM (Baseline + Final Only)
########################################

# 3.1 Baseline (Visit == 1)
baseline <- oasis %>%
  filter(visit == 1) %>%
  select(
    subject_id,
    age_baseline = age,
    educ_baseline = educ,
    sex_baseline  = sex,
    cdr_baseline  = cdr,
    group_baseline = group,
    mmse_baseline = mmse
  )

# 3.2 Final visit per subject (max visit)
final <- oasis %>%
  group_by(subject_id) %>%
  filter(visit == max(visit)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    subject_id,
    visit_final = visit,
    time_years_final = time_years,
    mmse_final = mmse,
    poor_cognition_final = poor_cognition
  )

# 3.3 Merge baseline + final
glm_dat <- baseline %>%
  inner_join(final, by = "subject_id") %>%
  mutate(
    delta_mmse = mmse_final - mmse_baseline
  )

# Keep only subjects with at least 2 visits (otherwise baseline == final)
glm_dat <- glm_dat %>%
  filter(visit_final > 1)

########################################
## 4. GLM Models
########################################

########################################
## 4.1 RQ1 — Logistic GLM (poor cognition)
########################################

glm_rq1 <- glm(
  poor_cognition_final ~ age_baseline + educ_baseline + sex_baseline +
    cdr_baseline + group_baseline,
  data = glm_dat,
  family = binomial()
)

summary(glm_rq1)

### Odds ratios (constant across covariates)
or_table <- exp(cbind(OR = coef(glm_rq1), confint(glm_rq1)))
or_table

### Predicted probabilities
# Extract the dataset actually used in fitting the model
glm_dat_used <- model.frame(glm_rq1)

# Add predicted probabilities
glm_dat_used$pred_prob <- predict(glm_rq1, type = "response")

# Classification
glm_dat_used$pred_class <- if_else(glm_dat_used$pred_prob > 0.5, 1, 0)

# Confusion matrix
table(Predicted = glm_dat_used$pred_class,
      Observed = glm_dat_used$poor_cognition_final)


########################################
## Discrimination: ROC & AUC
########################################

roc_obj <- roc(glm_dat_used$poor_cognition_final, glm_dat_used$pred_prob)
auc(roc_obj)

plot(roc_obj, col = "blue", main = "ROC Curve for Logistic GLM")

########################################
## Calibration: predicted vs observed
########################################

glm_dat <- glm_dat %>%
  mutate(prob_bin = cut(pred_prob, breaks = seq(0,1,0.1), include.lowest = TRUE))

calibration <- glm_dat %>%
  group_by(prob_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pred = mean(pred_prob),
    mean_obs  = mean(poor_cognition_final)
  )

print(calibration)

ggplot(calibration, aes(x = mean_pred, y = mean_obs)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Calibration Plot", x = "Predicted Probability", y = "Observed Proportion")

########################################
## Residuals, leverage, influence
########################################

# Deviance residuals
plot(residuals(glm_rq1, type = "deviance"), 
     main = "Deviance Residuals")

# Leverage and influence
plot(glm_rq1, which = 4)   # Cook's distance
plot(glm_rq1, which = 5)   # Residuals vs leverage

########################################
## Linearity check on logit scale
########################################

# Box-Tidwell requires positive predictors. If needed, add a small constant.
library(car)
boxTidwell(poor_cognition_final ~ age_baseline + educ_baseline, data = glm_dat)

########################################
## Hosmer-Lemeshow Goodness-of-Fit
########################################

library(ResourceSelection)
hoslem.test(glm_dat$poor_cognition_final, fitted(glm_rq1))

########################################
## Multicollinearity
########################################

vif(glm_rq1)

########################################
## Optional: try nonlinear terms (re-specification)
########################################

glm_rq1_quad <- glm(
  poor_cognition_final ~ poly(age_baseline, 2) + educ_baseline + sex_baseline +
    cdr_baseline + group_baseline,
  data = glm_dat,
  family = binomial()
)

AIC(glm_rq1, glm_rq1_quad)


### 4.2 RQ2: Change in MMSE (linear GLM)

glm_rq2 <- lm(
  delta_mmse ~ age_baseline + educ_baseline + sex_baseline +
    cdr_baseline + group_baseline,
  data = glm_dat
)

summary(glm_rq2)

# Diagnostics (for RQ2 linear model)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(glm_rq2)   # residuals, Q-Q, etc.
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
